data.titulo: Ekicweka 7—Okuhumbuuka kwa Yesu Kuhika ha Kutekebwa mu Nkomo kwa Paulo
data.contenido:
Ebiro bisatu hanyuma y’okufa kwe, Yesu akahumbuurwa. Hakiro ekyo kyonyini, akeyoleka abakurasi be emirundi etaano ey’embaganiza. Yesu akeyongera kubeyoleka okumara ebiro 40. Hanyuma, obu abakwenda be bakaba nibarora, Yesu akatemba omu iguru. Hunyuma y’ebiro ikumi, Ruhanga akaha omwoyo ogurukwera abakurasi ba Yesu abakaba balindiriire omu Yerusalemu.

Hanyuma, abanyanzigwa ba Ruhanga bakakwata abakwenda babateeka mu nkomo, baitu maraika yaija yabasumurra. Omukwenda Sutefano akateerwa amabaale, yaitwa abo abakaba nibahakaniza. Baitu nitwegaho nkoku Yesu yakomere omu hali abo abamuhakanizaga okuba omuhereza we ow’embaganiza, kandi onu niwe yafookere omukwenda Paulo. Hanyuma y’okurabaho emyaka esatu n’ekicweka Yesu amazire kufa, Ruhanga akatuma Petero kutebeza hali ogu owakaba atali Muyudaya, Koruneryo n’amaka ge.

Hanyuma y’okuhinguraho emyaka 13, Paulo akatandika orugendo rwe rw’okubanza orw’okutebeza. Ha rugendo rwe orwa kabiri, Timoseo nawe akamweteranizaho. Nitwega bingi nkoku Paulo n’abataahi be batungire emigisa nyingi kuruga mukuhereza Ruhanga. Hamperu, Paulo akakwatwa yateekwa mu nkomo mu Rumi. Hanyuma y’emyaka ebiri akataisurwa, baitu bakagaruka bamuteeka mu nkomo n’okumwita. Ebyabaireho MUKICWEKA 7 bikabaho mu myaka 32.

NOMANYA omukazi n’abasaija babiri banu nibo baaha? Omukazi nuwe Malyamu Magadalena munywani wa Yesu. Kandi abasaija mungoye ezirukwera bamaraika. Kanu akasiika Malyamu akakuroramu nuho bakaba bataire omutumbi gwa Yesu hanyuma y’okufa. Nikyetwa ekituuro. Baitu hati omutumbi tigulimu! N’oha yagutwaire? Katurole.

Hanyuma y’okufa kwa Yesu, abanyakatagara bakagamba Pirato: ‘Yesu obwakaba akyali mwomezi akagamba ngu naija kuhumbuurwa hanyuma y’ebiro bisatu. Kale ragira ekituuro kirindwe. Nukwo abegeswa be baleke kwija n’okwiba omutumbi gwe kandi bagambe ngu ahumbwirwe okuruga mubafu!’ Pirato yagamba abanyakatagara kutuma abaserikale kulinda ekituuro.

Baitu nyenkya kara muno ha kiro kyakasatu hanyuma y’okufa kwa Yesu, maraika wa Yahwe akaija ahonaho. Akasindika ibaale kuruga ha kituuro. Abaserikale bakatiinira kimu tibasobora n’okwetengesaho. Hanyuma obubarora mu kituro munda, omutumbi tigulimu! Abamu h’abaserikale bagenda mu rubuga kandi bagambira banyakatagara. Omanyire abanyakatagara banu ababi ekibakora? Basasura abaserikale kubiiha. Babagambira bati: ‘Mugambe ngu abegesebwa be baizire ekiro obu tubaire tubwamire baiba omutumbi.’

Binu obu bikaba nibibaho, abamu h’abakazi abakaba bali banywani ba Yesu babungira ekituuro. Bakahunirra kusanga ekituro kitalimu kintu! Mubwangu bamaraika babiri mubijwaro birikwangasana baija. Babakaguza bati: ‘Habwaki nimuserra Yesu hanu? Ahumbwirwe. Mugende bwangu mugambire abegeswa be.’ Abakazi bairuka bwangu! Baitu bakaba bakyali mu muhanda omusaija yabemereza. Omanyire noha? Ni Yesu! Abagambira ati: ‘Mugende mugambire abegeswa bange.’

Abakazi obu bagambiire abegeswa ngu Yesu mwomezi kandi ngu bamurozere, abegesebwa kikabagumira kwikiriza kinu. Petero na Yohana bairuka kugenda ha kituuro kwerorra, baitu basanga ekituuro kitarimu kintu! Petero na Yohana obu barugireyo, Malyamu Magadalena asigarayo. Nubwo yarozere mukituuro kandi akarora bamaraika babiri.

Omanyire kiki ekyahikire ha mutumbi gwa Yesu? Ruhanga akagubuzaho. Ruhanga atahumbule Yesu mu mubiri ogw’enyama ogu yafeeriiremu. Akaha Yesu omubiri ogw’omwoyo omuhyaka, nk’abamaraika omwiguru ogu baine. Baitu habw’okwoleka abegesebwa be ngu ali mwomezi, Yesu yayetekahoga omubiri ogw’abantu ogu basoboraga kurora nkoku turarora.Matayo 27:62-66; 28:1-15; Luka 24:1-12; Yohana 20:1-12. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

HANYUMA ya Petero na Yohana okuruga ha kituro nambere omutumbi gwa Yesu gukaba guli, Malyamu bamusigayo wenka. Atandika kurra. Nubwo yainamire kandi akarora mukituuro nkoku turozire mukisisani eky’enyuma. Akarora bamaraika babiri! Bakamukaguza: ‘Habwaki norra?’

Malyamu abagarukamu ati: ‘Batwaire Mukama wange, kandi timanyire nambere bamutaire.’ Nubwo Malyamu yahinduka kandi akarora omusaija. Omusaija akaguza Malyamu ati: ‘Nosserra oha?’

Malyamu natekereza ngu omusaija onu nuwe mulinzi w’orugonjo, nti kandi nuwe asobora kuba yatwaire omubiri gwa Yesu. Nubwo yagamba: ‘Obworaba niwe omutwaire, ngambira nambere omutaire.’ Baitu mananu omusaija onu ni Yesu. Ajwaire omubiri Malyamu ogwatasobora kumanyirra. Baitu obu yamwesere nakozesa ibara lye, Malyamu ayetegereza ngu onu ni Yesu. Airuka agenda agambira abegeswa ati: ‘Ndozire Mukama!’

Hanyuma ekiro eki, abegeswa be babiri obubakaba nibarubata nibagenda mu kyaro Emau, omusaija aija arubata nabo. Abegeswa basaliirwe muno habwokuba Yesu aisirwe. Baitu obu babaire nibarubata, omusaija abasoborra bingi kuruga omu Baibuli ebyabaletiire kuhurra kurungi. Hanyuma, obu bayemeriireho kutunga ekyokulya, abageswa betegereza ngu omusaija onu nuwe Yesu. Aho nubwo Yesu yababuzireho, kandi abegeswa banu babiri banguha bagaruka Yerusalemu okugambira abakwenda ebikumukwataho.

Binu obu bikaba nibibaho, Yesu ayeyoleka Petero. Abandi begeswa basemererwa obu bakihuliire. Nubwo na banu abegeswa ababiri bagenda Yerusalemu kandi bahika ha bakwenda. Babagambira nkoku Yesu nabo abeyolekere mumuhanda. Kandi obubakaba nibakyagamba hali binu, omanyire ekyokuhuniriza ekyabaireho?

Dora ha kisisani. Yesu akeyoleka mukisiika n’obu kiri ngu orwigi rukaba rukingirwe. Abegeswa kabakasemererwa! Ekyo tikiri kiro ky’omuhimbo? Hati nosobora kubara emirundi Yesu eyi ayeyolekere abegeswa be? Obazire emirundi etaano?

Omukwenda Tomasi akaba tali nabo Yesu obu yabeyolekere. Nahabwekyo abegeswa baamugamba bati: ‘Turozire Mukama!’ Baitu Tomasi agamba ngu aine kwerorra Yesu, nukwo aikirize. Mali hanyuma y’ebiro munaana, abegeswa bali hamu mukisiika ekikingirwe, kandi ha murundi gunu Tomasi ali nabo. Ahonaho Yesu ayeyoleka mukisiika. Hati Tomasi aikiriza.Yohana 20:11-29; Luka 24:13-43. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

EBIRO obu birabaho, Yesu ayeyoleka hali abakurasi be emirundi nyingi. Murundi gumu abegeswa 500 bakamurora. Yesu obu yayeyolekere halibo, nomanya kiki eki yagambireho nabo? Obukama bwa Ruhanga. Yahwe akatuma Yesu kwija munsi kwegesa ha Bukama. Kandi ayeyongera kukora kinu na hanyuma y’okuhumbuurwa kuruga mubafu.

Noijuka obukama bwa Ruhanga nikyo kiki? Mali, obukama nibwo bulemi bwonyini obwa Ruhanga obwomu iguru, kandi Yesu nuwe Ruhanga yakomere kuba omukama. Nkoku tumazire kwega Yesu akoleka ngu naija kuba omukama murungi obu yalisize abaine enjara, obu yakirize abarwaire kandi nobu yahumbwire abafu!

Yesu obu alirema nk’omukama ow’omu iguru kumara emyaka rukumi, kiriba kita mu nsi? Mali ensi yoona erifoorwa orugonjo rwa Ruhanga orurungi muno. Tihalibaho bulemu, rundi okucwa ebiragiro, rundi oburwaire, rundi okufa. Nitumanya ngu kinu ky’amananu habwokuba Ruhanga akakora ensi okuba orugonjo rwa Ruhanga orw’abantu kusemerererwamu. Enu niyo nsonga habwaki yakozire orugonjo rwa Adeni mukubanza. Kandi Yesu naija kurora ngu Ruhanga ebyagonza nibihikirizibwa.

Obwire bukahika Yesu okugaruka omu iguru. Kumara ebiro 40 Yesu abaire nayeyoleka abegeswa be. Nahabwekyo nibasobora kukigumya ngu agarukire kuba omwomezi. Baitu atakalekereho abageswa be, akabagambira ati: ‘Mwikale Yerusalemu okuhikya obu mulitunga omwoyo gurukwera.’ Omwoyo ogurukwera nigo maani ga Ruhanga agakora agakusisana omuyaga, agakaba nigagenda kukonyera abegeswa be okukora Ruhanga ebyagonza. Mukumalirra, Yesu agamba ati: ‘Musemerire kuntebezaho kuhika mu bicweka eby’ensi ebya hara muno.’

Hanyuma y’okugamba binu, eky’okuhuniriza kibaho. Atandika kugenda mu iguru nkoku orukurora hanu. Nubwo ekicu kyamusiikiriza, kandi abegeswa be batagaruke kumurora obundi. Yesu akagenda omu iguru kandi yatandika kulema abegeswa be abakaba bali munsi.1 Abakolinso 15:3-8; Okusuku’rwa 21:3, 4; Engeso 1:1-11. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

ABANTU banu begeswa ba Yesu. Bamworobiire, n’okusigara mu Yerusalemu. Boona obu baba balindiriire hamu, okuhiirra kwijura enju yoona. Nikusisana nk’okuhiirra kw’omuyaga ogw’amaani. Kandi nubwo endiimi z’omu’ro zayolekebwa haiguru ya habuli mutwe gw’omwegeswa. Norora omu’ro haiguru ya buli omu? Binu byoona nibimanyisa ki?

Kinu kyamahano! Yesu agarukireyo omu iguru ali hamu na Ise, kandi naseesa omwoyo gwa Ruhanga ogurukwera ha begeswa be. Omanyire omwoyo gunu eki gubaletera kukora? Boona batandika kubaza mu ndimi ezitakusisana.

Abantu baingi mu Yerusalemu bahurra okuhiirra okwasisaine nk’omuyaga ogw’amaani, kandi baija kurora ekyabaho. Abantu abamu bakaba barugire mu mahanga agandi kwija hanu mu Yerusalemu ha kukuza Pentekoti. Abagenyi banu kabakatunga ekyokuhunirra! Bahurra abageswa nibabaza mu ndimi zabo habikukwata ha bintu ebyamahano Ruhanga ebyakozire.

Abagenyi bakekaguza bati: ‘Abantu banu boona nibaruga Galiraaya. Nibasobora bata kubaza mu ndimi ezirukusisana n’ez’omunsi y’owaitu?’

Petero ayemerra kubasoborra. Mwiraka lihango, agambira abantu nkoku Yesu yaisirwe kandi nkoku Yahwe yamuhumbwire kuruga mubafu. Petero agamba ati: ‘Hati Yesu ali mwiguru ha mukono gw’obulyo ogwa Ruhanga, kandi aseesere omwoyo ogurukwera ogwanihiziibwe. Nikyo muroliire kandi mwahurra ebyamahano binu.’

Petero obu yagambire binu, abantu baingi batunga okusasa mumutima habw’ebyakozerwe hali Yesu. Bakaguza bati: ‘Hati tukole ki?’ Petero abagambira ati: ‘Nikibetagise kuhindura ha ngeso zaanyu kandi mubatizibwe.’ Kale ha kiro ekyo, abantu haihi 3000 babatizibwa kandi bafooka abakurasi ba Yesu.Engeso 2:1-47. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

DORA hanu maraika akingwire orwigi rw’enkomo. Abasaija abarukusumu’ra bakwenda ba Yesu. Katuzoole akyabaletire kuba munkomo.

Harabireho akanya kake kuruga obu abegeswa ba Yesu baseswaho omwoyo ogurukwera. Kandi kinu nikyo kyabaireho: Mwihangwe limu, Petero na Yohana bakaba nibagenda mu yekaru mu Yerusalemu. Aho haihi n’orwigi, hali haroho omusaija ayabaire mulema obwomezibwe bwoona. Buli kiro abantu bamuletaga hanu nukwo asabirize sente h’abantu abarukwija mu yekaru. Obu yarozire Petero na Yohana, yabasaba bamuhe kyoona eki baine. Abakwenda baakukozire ki?

Bemerra kandi barolerra omusaija onu omunaku. Petero amugamba ati: ‘Tinyina sente, baitu ninyija kukuha ekinyina. Mwibara lya Yesu, imuka orubate!’ Nubwo Petero aimukya omusaija n’omukono gwe ogw’obulyo, kandi mubwangu aguruka kandi atandika kurubata. Abantu obu barora kinu, bahunirra kandi basemererwa habw’ekyamahano kinu ekirungi.

Petero agamba ati: ‘Tukozeseze amaani ga Ruhanga ayahumbwire Yesu mubafu kukora ekyamahano kinu.’ Petero na Yohana obu bakaba nibakyagamba, abamu h’abakuru b’edini baija. Babihirirwa Petero na Yohana habw’okuba nibagambira abantu ha kuhumbuurwa kwa Yesu kuruga mu bafu. Nahabwekyo babakwata babateeka mu nkomo.

Ekiro ekyagarukireho abakuru b’ediini batunga orukurato rukoto. Petero Yohana hamu n’omusaija ou baakirize baleetwa mu maiso gabu. Abakuru b’ediini babakaguza bati: ‘Mukozire ekyamahano kinu mu maani goha?’

Petero agamba ngu bakozeseze amaani ga Ruhanga ayahumbwire Yesu mubafu. Banyakatagara tibakumanya ekyokukora, habwokuba tibarukusobora kuhakana ngu ekyamahano kinu ekikuhuniriza kibaireho. Nahabwekyo barabura abakwenda obutagarukira kugamba hali Yesu omurundi ogundi, kandi babaleka bagenda.

Ebiro obu bihinguraho, abakwenda beyongera kutebeza hali Yesu kandi n’okukiza abarwaire. Amakuru agarukukwata ha by’amahano binu gakasasana. Kandi nubwo ebitebe by’abantu okuruga mubibuga ekwetorora Yerusalemu baleta abarwaire hali abakwenda kubakiza. Kinu kireetera abakuru b’ediini kukwatwa ihali, nukwo bakwata abakwenda n’okubateeka munkomo. Baitu bataikaleyo kasumi kakooto.

Mukiro maraika wa Ruhanga akingura omulyango gw’enkomo nkoku orukurora hanu. Maraika abagamba ati: ‘Mugende kandi mwemerre mu yekaru kandi mweyongere okutebeza abantu.’ Obu abakuru b’ediini batuma abasaija mu nkomo kutabarra abakwenda nyenkya kara ha kiro ekyakurasireho, basanga batarumu. Hanyuma basanga abakwenda nibegesa mu yekaru kandi babaleta mu kisiika ky’abakuru b’ebiragiro.

Abakuru b’ediini bagamba bati: ‘Tukaabaragira obutagaruka kwegesa hali Yesu, baitu mwijwize Yerusalemu n’okwegesa kwanyu.’ Abakwenda babagarukamu bati: ‘Tusemerire kuhuliriza Ruhanga kukira kuhurra abantu.’ Nahabwekyo, bo beyongera okwegesa ‘amakuru amarungi.’ Kinu tikiri kyokurorraho kirungi eki tusemerire kukuratira?Engeso suura 3 kuhika 5. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

OMUSAIJA atiize amaju hanu nuwe Sitefano. Mwegeswa wa Yesu omwesigwa. Baitu dora ekikumuhikaho! Abasaija banu nibamuhungurra amabale amakooto. Habwaki banobere Sitefano kuhika hanu, n’okukora ekikorwa kinu ekibi? Katurole.

Ruhanga abaire nakonyera Sitefano okukora ebyamahano ebikuhuniiriza. Binu bitasemeze abasaija banu, nubwo kutandika kumuteza empaka ha bikwatiraine n’amananu agaakaba nayegesa abantu. Baitu Ruhanga akaha Sitefano amagezi maingi, kandi Sitefano ayoleka abantu banu oku babaire nibegesa eby’ebisuba. Kinu kibaletera kweyongera kubihirwa. Nukwo bamukwata, kandi beeta abantu bamubazeho eby’ebisuba.

Nyakatagara omukuru akaguza Sitefano ati: ‘Binu ni mananu?’ Sitefano yagarukamu naha orubazo orurungi kuruga mu Baibuli. Hakumalirra kwarwo, yagamba h’abasaija ababi nkoku bayangire abarangi ba Yahwe abaira. Abagamba ati: ‘Nimusisana abasaija abo. Mukaita omuhereza wa Ruhanga Yesu, kandi timworobire ebiragiro bya Ruhanga.’

Kinu kiretera abakuru b’ediini banu kubihirwa muno! Banena amaino gabo n’ekiniga. Kyonka Sitefano yaimukya omutwe gwe kandi yagamba ati: ‘Dora!, nindora Yesu ayemerire ha rubaju rw’obulyo bwa Ruhanga omu iguru.’ Obu bahuliire kinu, abasaija banu bateka emikono yabo h’amatu gabo kandi bagwera Sitefano. Bamukwata kandi bamukurra bamutwara aheru y’orubuga.

Kunu beihaho eminagiro yabo kandi bagikwasa omusigazi Saulo kugirinda. Norora Saulo? Nubwo abasaija abamu batandika kutera Sitefano amabale. Sitefano ateza amaju, nk’oku orukurora, kandi asaba Ruhanga: ‘Yahwe otabajunana ekintu ekibi kinu.’ Amanyire ngu abamu halibo bahabisibwe abakuru b’ediini. Hanyuma ya kinu Sitefano afa.

Omuntu kakuba akukora ekibi, olengaho naiwe kumukora kubi, rundi osaba Ruhanga amukole kubi? Sitefano na Yesu tikuli nukwo bakozere. Bakagirra embabazi abo ababakozire kubi. Katulengeho kuhondera eky’okurorraho kyabo.Engeso 6:8-15; 7:1-60. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

NOMANYA ogu anyakubyamire hansi? Nuwe Saulo. Ijuka ngu nuwe yalinzire eminagiro y’abasaija abatire Sitefano amabale. Dora ekyererezi eky’amaani! Kiki ekibaireho hati?

Hanyuma y’okwitwa kwa Sitefano, Saulo akebembera abakaba nibaserra abegeswa ba Yesu kubakora kubi. Yagendaga nju ha nju nabasikamburamu nabatwara mu nkomo. Baingi ha begeswa ba Yesu bakairuka bagenda mubibuga bindi kandi batandika kutebeza ‘amakuru amarungi’ oku. Baitu Saulo yagenda omubibuga ebindi kuserra abegeswa ba Yesu. Hati ali mu muhanda nagenda Damasiko. Baitu obu akaba akyali mumuhanda, kinu ekintu ekikuhuniriza kikabaho:

Ahonaho, ekimyanso kuruga haiguru kyehinguliriza Saulo. Agwa hansi nkoku turukurora hanu. Hanyuma nubwo iraka lyagamba: ‘Saulo, Saulo! Nompiganira ki?’ Abasaija abakaba na Saulo bakarora ekyererezi kandi bakahurra okugamba kwiraka, baitu batasobole kwetegereza ebikaba nibigambwa.

‘Niwoha Mukama, wange?’ Saulo yakaguza.

‘Ninyowe Yesu ow’orukuhiganiza,’ Iraka liba nikwo lyagamba. Yesu agamba ngu Saulo obu ahiganiza abakurasi ba Yesu, aba nahiganiza Yesu wonyini.

Saulo hati akaguza: ‘Nkoleki, Mukama wange?’

Yesu amugambira ati: ‘Imuka, ogende otaahe mu Damasiko, oku oragambirwa ekyokukora.’ Saulo obu yaimukire kandi yagonza kurora, atasobole kurora kintu kyoona. Hati kihimbaara! Nubwo abasaija abakaba bali nawe bamukwata ha mukono kandi bamutahya mu Damasiko.

Yesu hati yagambira omu ha bakurasi be mu Damasiko ati: ‘Imuka Ananiya. Genda omu muhanda ogw’orubuga ogurukwetwa Literekirire. Hanju ya Yuda okaguze omusaija arukwetwa Saulo. Mukomere okuba omuhereza wange ow’embaganiza.’

Ananiya aikiriza. Obu yatangaine Saulo, yamutaho engaro kandi yagamba: ‘Mukama antumire nukwo osobole kugaruka kurora kandi oijuzibwe omwoyo ogurukwera.’ Aho naho ebintu ebikusisana nk’ebikoko byaragara kuruga ha maiso ga Saulo, kandi yasobora kugaruka kurora.

Saulo yakozesebwa mumulingo ogw’embaganiza kutebeza abantu ab’amahanga maingi. Akamanywa nk’omukwenda Paulo ou turukwija kwegaho bingi. Baitu katubanze twetegereze Ruhanga eki yatumire Petero kukora.Engeso 8:1-4; 9:1-20; 22:6-16; 26:8-20. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

OGU ayameriire aho nuwe omukwenda Petero kandi abo abali enyuma ye bamu ha banywani be. Baitu habwaki omusaija onu nainamira Petero? Asemerire kukora ekyo? Nomanya nuwe oha?

Omusaija onu nuwe Koruneryo. Mukuru mwihe ry’Abarumi. Koruneryo tamanyire Petero, Baitu akagambirwa okumusembeza munju ye. Katuzole nkoku kinu kyabaireho.

Abakurasi ab’okubanza aba Yesu bakaba Bayudaaya, baitu Koruneryo tali Muyudaya. Nagonza Ruhanga kandi namusaba, kandi akorra abantu ebintu bingi ebirungi. Mwihangwe limu, maraika akamubonekera kandi yamugamba ati: ‘Ruhanga akusemererirwe kandi naija kugarukamu okusaba kwawe. Tuma abasaija batabarre omusaija arukwetwa Petero. Naikara mu Yoppa mu nju ya Simoni arukwikara haihi n’enyanja.’

Mubwangu Koruneryo yatuma abasaija kuserra Petero. Ekiro ekya garukireho, abasaija banu obu bakaba bali haihi kuhika Yoppa, Petero akaba ali ha rusu oruterekerire orw’enju ya Simoni. Hanu Ruhanga yasukurra Petero orugoye rukooto orwasirimukire kuruga mu iguru. Murugoye halimu ebisoro ebyabuli mulingo. Kusigikirra ha biragiro bya Ruhanga, ebisoro binu tibisemerire kuliibwa, baitu iraka lyagamba: ‘Petero, Imuka oite kandi olye.’

Petero yagarukamu ati: ‘Nangwa! Tinkalyaga ekitasemiire.’ Baitu iraka lyagambira Petero: ‘Otagaruka kweta ebi Ruhanga yayereze ebitasemiire.’ Kinu kyabaho emirundi esatu. Obu Petero akaba nakyecumitiriza binu kiki eki birukumanyisa, abasaija abakaba batumirwe Koruneryo bahika hanju kandi bakaguza Petero nambere ali.

Petero yasirimuka h’amadaara kandi yagamba ati: ‘Ninyowe ou mukuserra. Habwaki mwizire?’ Abasaija banu obu basoboroire ngu maraika akagambira Koruneryo okusaba Petero kwija munjuye, Petero yaikiriza kugenda nabo. Ekiro ekyagarukireho, Petero n’abanywani be baruga hanu bagenda kubungira Koruneryo mu Kaisaliya.

Koruneryo akaba asoroize abanyabuzale n’abanywani be. Petero obu yaizire, Koruneryo yamutangana. Yagwa hansi yainama ha bigere bya Petero, nkoku orukurora hanu. Baitu Petero yagamba ati: ‘Imuka, nanye ndi muntu buntu kaiwe.’ Ego Baibuli neyoleka ngu tikihikire kwinamira kandi okaramya omuntu. Tusemerire kuramya Yahwe wenka.

Petero hati atebeza abo abakaba besoroize. Yagamba: ‘Nindora Ruhanga naikiriza abantu boona abarukugonza kumuhereza.’ Obu aba nakyabaza, Ruhanga atweka omwoyo ogurukwera, kandi abantu batandika kugamba omu ndimi ezitarukusisana. Kinu kikahunihiriza abegeswa abakaba bali Bayudaya abakaba baizire na Petero, habwokuba bakaba nibatekereza ngu Ruhanga nasiima Abayudaya bonka. Kinu kikabegesa ngu Ruhanga tarukutwara abantu b’ihanga limu kuba ab’omuhendo kukira ab’ihanga erindi. Kinu tikiri kintu kirungi buli kiro kukiijukaga?Engeso 10:1-48; 11:1-18; Okusuku’rwa 19:10. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

OMUSIGAZI ow’okurora hanu n’omukwenda Paulo nuwe Timoseo. Timoseo naikara n’abazaire be mu Rusitura. Nyina nibamweta Unike kandi nyinenkuru nayetwa Loi.

Gunu murundi gwa kasatu Paulo okubungira Rusitura. Hahoireho nk’omwaka kuruga Paulo na Barunaba babanza kwija hanu ha rugendo, rw’okutebeza. Kandi hati Paulo agarukire n’omunywani we Sira.

Omanyire Paulo ekyarukugambira Timoseo? Namukaguza ati ‘Wakugondeze kutweteranizaho, nyowe na Sira? Nosobora kutukoonyera mu kutebeza abantu mu biikaro byahara.’

Timoseo yagarukamu: ‘Ego, ningoza kugenda nainywe.’ Hanyuma y’akasumi kake, Timoseo alekaho abazaire be kandi agenda na Paulo na Sira. Baitu tutakegere ha rugendo rwabu, katubanze twetegereze ebibaire nibiba hali Paulo. Hati haihi myaka 17 kuruga Yesu amubonekera mu muhanda ogurukugenda Damasiko.

Ijuka, Paulo akaba nagenda Damasiko okubonabonesa abageswa ba Yesu, baitu hati nawe mwegeswa! Hanyuma, abanyanzigwa abamu batekaniza kwita Paulo habwokuba tibarukugonza ayegese hali Yesu. Baitu abegeswa bakonyera Paulo okutoroka. Bamuteeka mukigega bamusirimu’ra ha kisiika ky’orubuga.

Hanyuma, Paulo agenda Antyokiya kutebeza. Kunu nuho abegeswa ba Yesu baabandize kwetwa Abakristayo. Paulo na Barunaba batumwa kuruga Antyokiya kugenda murugendo rw’okutebeza munsi eza hara. Orubuga orumu oru babungiire rukaba Rusitura, nambere Timoseo akaba naikara.

Hati, hanyuma y’omwaka gumu, Paulo agarukire Rusitura ha rugendo rwakabiri. Timoseo obu yagenzire kunu na Paulo na Sira, omanyire nambere bagenzere? Dora ha maapu, kandi oyege ebiikaro ebimu. Okubanza, bagenda haihi na Ikonio, hanyuma, murubuga orwakabiri orurukwetwa Antyokiya. Hanyuma, bagenda Teroa, kandi beyongerayo Firipi, Sesalonika, na Beroya. Norora Asene ha maapu? Kunu naho Paulo akatebezayo. Hanyuma, bamara omwaka n’ekicweka nibatebeza mu Kolinso. Hampero, bemerraho kake mu Efeso. Hanyuma bagaruka Kaisaliya kandi bagenda Antyokiya, nambere Paulo akaba naikara.

Nahabwekyo, Timoseo agenda ebikumi n’ebikumi bya mairo nakonyera Paulo kutebeza ‘amakuru amarungi’ kandi n’okutandikaho ebitebe bingi eby’Abakristayo. Obworakura oraba omuhereza wa Ruhanga omwesigwa okusisana nka Timoseo?Engeso 9:19-30; 11:19-26; suura 13 kuhika 17; 18:1-22. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

MAHANO! Kiki ekibaire hanu? Omwojo onu anyakubyamire hansi ahutaire muno? Dora! Omu h’abasaija abarukuruga munju nuwe Paulo! Norora Timoseo nawe aroho? Omwojo onu ahanukire kuruga omu idirisa?

Mali, ekyo nikyo kyabaireho. Paulo akaba naha abakurasi orubazo hanu mu Teroa. Akaba namanya ngu tarukwija kugaruka kubarora kumara akasumi kakooto habwokuba ekiro ekyakurasireho, akaba nagenda n’eryato. Nubwo yabalize kuhikya mwitumbi.

Omwojo onu arukwetwa Yutuko akaba aikaliire ha idirisa kandi yagwijagira. Akagwa kuruga omu idirisa arya kaina yakasatu! Nikyo orukurorra abantu beralikiriire muno. Obu bakwasire ha mwojo, bakasanga afiire!

Paulo obu yarozire ngu omwojo afiire, yamubyamaho kandi yamufumbatira. Nubwo yagamba ati: ‘Mutatiina. Ali kurungi!’ Kandi mananu nukwo kiri! Kinu kyamahano! Paulo amuhumbwire! Ekitebe kyona kyatunga okusemererwa.

Boona batemba amadaara bagaruka haiguru kandi batunga eky’ekiro. Paulo ayeyongera kubabaliza kuhikya obwire obu bwakiire. Baitu nosobora kugumya ngu, Yutuko taragarukire kugwijagira! Nubwo Paulo, Timoseo n’abo abakaba nagenda nabo bagenda mu ryato. Baitu omanyire ei barukugenda? Paulo amalirize orugendo rwe orw’akasatu orw’okutebeza, kandi hati ali mu rugendo kugaruka owabu. Omu rugendo runu Paulo akamara emyaka esatu naikara mu rubuga rwa Efeso. Kale amazire akasumi kakoto mu rugendo runu kukira orwakabiri.

Abu barugire Teroa, eryato lyayemerraho Mireto okumara akasumi kake. Habwokuba Efeso teri hara na hanu, Paulo atumaho abagurusi b’ekitebe eki kwija Mireto asobole kubaza nabo omurundi ogurukuherrukayo. Hanyumaho obwire obu bwahikire eryato kugenda, kabakasalirwa muno kurora Paulo nabagendaho!

Hamperu, eryato ligaruka Kaisaliya. Obu Paulo akaba naikara hanu omunju y’omwegeswa Firipo, omurangi Agabo akamuhabura. Agamba ngu Paulo aija kufoorwa omunyankomo obu aragenda Yerusalemu. Kandi mazima kwo, kinu nikyo kyabaireho. Hanyuma, y’okuba mu nkomo emyaka ebiri mu Kaisaliya, Paulo bamwohereza Rumi okusalirwa omusango mu maiso ga Kaisali omulemi w’Abarumi. Katurole ebyabaireho murugendo rwe okugenda Rumi.Engeso suura 19 kuhika 26. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

DORA! Eryato litungire obuzibu! Licwekeremu ebicwekacweka! Norora abantu abagwire omumaizi? Abamu bahikire ha Musa. Ogu tali Paulo? Leka turole ekimubaireho.

Ijuka, Paulo akamara emyaka ebiri nk’omunyankomo omu Kaisaliya. Hanyuma, uwe n’abanyankomo abandi bakabateeka omuryato kubatwara Rumi. Obu babaire nibaraba haihi n’ekizinga ekya Kerete, ihunga ly’amaani lyabatera. Omuyaga gukaba gw’amaani gwabalemesa kuterekereza eryato. Kandi baali batarukusobora kurora izooba nyamusana rundi enyunyuzi obwire bw’ekiro. Hanyuma y’ebiro bingi, abo abakaba bali omuryato bakahwamu okunihira kw’okukizibwa.

Hanyuma Paulo akemerra yabagambira ati: ‘Busaho nomu arafeerwa obwomezi bwe; eryato niryo lyonka erirasiisikara. Omwitumbi, maraika wa Ruhanga aiziire yangambira ati: “Paulo! Otatiina noija kwemerra omu maiso ga Kaisali omulemi wa Rumi, kandi Ruhanga naija kujuna abo boona aboinabo.”’

Mwitumbi ery’ekiro kya 14 hanyuma y’ihunga, abalimba baketegereza ngu amaizi gakehere. Habw’okutiina kutomera emyandara omu mwirima, bakanaga enanga. Ekiro ekyakurasireho, barora omusa. Nukwo bacwamu kutwara eryato ha mwogo.

Obu babaire bali haihi kuhika ha mwogo, nubwo eryato ryatomiire omukungu gw’omusenyu nukwo kutobera. Ebigonzi nukwo kutandika kulitera, likacwekacwekamu. Omukuru w’ekihanda nukwo kugamba ati: ‘Abo boona abarukusobora kuziha, mugwe munyanja, muzihe muhike ha Musa. Abandi mubakurate, kandi mukwatirre ha bicweka by’eryato.’ Kandi ekyo nikyo bakora. Mumulingo gunu abantu boona 276 abaali muryato nukwo basobora kuhika ha Musa kurungi, nkoku maraika yaraganisize.

Ekizinga kinu nikyetwa Merita. Abantu hanu nab’ekisa muno, kandi bayamba muno boona abakaba bali muryato. Obwire obu bwasemiire, Paulo atekebwa muryato erindi okutwarwa Rumi.Engeso 27:1-44; 28:1-14. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

DORA enjegere eziri hali Paulo, kandi dora n’omusirikale Omurumi arukumulinda. Paulo munyankomo omu Rumi. Akaba alindiriire kiki Kaisali Omurumi ekyaramusarramu. Obwakaba akyali munyankomo, abantu baikirizibwaga okumubungira.

Ebiro bisatu hanyuma ya Paulo kuhika Rumi, akeeta abakuru b’Abayudaya kwija kumurora. Ekyarugiremu, Abayudaya baingi abakaba nibaikara omu Rumi bakaija. Paulo akabatebeza hali Yesu n’aha Bukama bwa Ruhanga. Abamu bakaikiriza bafooka Bakristayo, baitu abandi bakanga kwikiriza.

Paulo akatebeza n’abasirikale abakaba baine omulimo gw’okumulinda. Okumara emyaka ebiri ei yamazire hanu omunkomo, Paulo akatebeza buli omu ou yabonaga. Nekyarugiremu, n’amaka ga Kaisali gakahurra amakuru amarungi ag’Obukama, hanyuma abamu bakafooka Abakristayo. Baitu onu omugenyi anyakuli ha meza nahandika nuwe oha? Nosobora kumuteeba? Ego nuwe Timoseo. Timoseo nawe akabaho munyankomo habw’okutebeza ha Bukama, baitu hati akaba ataiswirwe. Akaba aizire hanu kukonyera Paulo. Nomanya eki Timoseo akaba nahandika? Katurole.

Noijuka ebibuga ebya Firipi na Efeso mu Ruganikyo orwa 110? Paulo akakonyera muno okutandikaho ebitebe by’Ekikristayo mu bibuga binu. Hati, Paulo obu akaba ali munkomo nukwo kuhandikira Abakristayo banu ebbaruha. Ebbaruha zinu ziri omu Baibuli, kandi nizetwa Abafeso na Abafiripi. Hati Paulo nagambira Timoseo kiki ekyokuhandikira abanywani babu Abakristayo ab’omu Firipi.

Abafiripi bakoleka Paulo ekisa kingi. Bakamutwekera n’ekisembo hanu munkomo, nahabwekyo hati Paulo n’abasiima. Epafurodito nuwe musaija ayabiresire. Baitu, akarwara muno haihi n’okufa. Hati akizire kandi ayetekaniize kugarukayo owabu. Naija kutwara ebbaruha erikuruga hali Paulo na Timoseo obu aragarukayo Firipi.

Obwakaba ali munkomo Paulo akahandiika ebbaruha ezindi ibiri ezitwine omu Baibuli. Emu hali Abakristayo ab’omu rubuga rwa Kolosai. Nomanya nkoku erukwetwa? Neyetwa Abakolosai. Ebbaruha endi ekaba eri ya munywani we arukumanywa nka Firemoni arukwikara mu Kolosai. Ebbaruha enu ekaba nekwata hali Onesimo omukozi wa Firemoni.

Onesimo akatoroka kuruga hali Firemoni kandi yagenda Rumi. Onesimo akamanya nkoku Paulo ali mu nkomo mu Rumi. Akaija kumubungira, nubwo Paulo yatebiize Onesimo. Hanyuma y’akasumi kake, Onesimo nawe akafooka Omukristayo. N’ahabwekyo Onesimo akehurra kubi habw’okutoroka. Nomanya eki Paulo arukuhandikira Firemoni omu bbaruha enu?

Paulo nasaba Firemoni okuganyira Onesimo. Paulo akahandika ati: ‘Nimukutwekera. Hati tali mukozi kyonka. Baitu Mukristayo omurungi muno.’ Obu Onesimo agarukayo mu Kolosai atwara ebbaruha zinu ibiri, emu agitwarra Abakolosai kandi endi hali Firemoni. Nitusobora kukicumitirizaho nkoku Firemoni yahuliire obu yamanyire ngu omukozi we akaba afookere Omukristayo.

Paulo obu yahandikiire Abafiripi na Firemoni, mananu akaba aine amakuru marungi. Paulo agambira Abafiripi ati; ‘Nimbatumira Timoseo. Beitu na nyowe ninyija kubarora mukanya akatali kahara.’ Kandi hali Firemoni akahandika ati: ‘Ntekaniriza omwanya gw’okwikaramu oku.’

Paulo obu yalekiirwe akabungira ab’oruganda mubiikaro bingi. Baitu hanyuma, Paulo akatebwa munkomo omu Rumi. Ha murundi gunu, namanya ngu nagenda kwitwa. Nahabwekyo ahandikira Timoseo kwija bwangu. Paulo akahandiika ati: ‘Mbaire mwesigwa hali Ruhanga, Ruhanga naija kunsasura.’ Emyaka mike Paulo obu yamazire kwitwa, Yerusalemu nayo ekahwerekerezebwa Abarumi.

Baitu mu Baibuli harumu ebindi bingi muno. Yahwe Ruhanga aletera omukwenda Yohana okuhandika ebitabu ebirikusembayo otwaliremu n’ekitabu kya Okusuku’rwa. Ekitabu kinu ekya Baibuli nikigambaho ha biro eby’omu maiso. Katurole ebirikukwata ha biro eby’omumaiso.Engeso 28:16-31; Abafiripi 1:13; 2:19-30; 4:18-23; Abaheburaniya 13:23; Firemoni 1-25; Abakolosai 4:7-9; 2 Timoseo 4:7-9. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega
